If you could get in touch with us to explain what happened, we would really appreciate it so we are able to provide feedback and training to our staff. 
Regarding the online form system, all triages go through to a GP who reviews the urgency of our patient’s issues, who is in contact to inform that patient of the outcome. We do feel that this is a much safer way to process our patient’s issues, due to a medical professional being the first to view the details.
